self.text: Hi there! I'm Samir, a non-binary Kenyan in my mid 30s. When I'm not behind the lens, I spend a lot of my time podcasting, which I love because it lets me explore so many different stories. I use a Nikon for my photography. Regarding our time together, I'm honestly just looking for a structured instruction session. Fair warning, plenty of gear talk is my thing! As for editing, I'm happy to teach post-processing. I'm also cool with not taking portraits of each other during our outings. In terms of scheduling, most weeks I can do Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings. I'm looking forward to getting out there and capturing some great shots in a relaxed atmosphere.
